card.name: Vague 'at some point' time phrases
card.fires_on: The last word of vague time phrases such as "at some point", "at any point", "at one point", "someday" or "eventually", where a clause about an unspecified time is about to continue.

card.writes: It seems to push against words that begin "whenever" or "each time" clauses, so the text continues with something other than a time clause.
card.plain: It lights up on loose time phrases like "at some point" or "someday" that don't give a specific time.
